The story of the Embalmer attributes her revival and hunger for human flesh to his placing his own heart inside her dead body.

Bookie Herod is described as Kurzen’s logistics officer and Thorsen’s contact in the camp, with knowledge of how the compound ran. Records associated with him include a ledger containing a hidden key and notes mentioning a secure strongbox.
Harl Cutter is associated with woodcrafting supplies.
A creature known as Feral Spirit.

A bone caster, an undead spellcaster.

Corbett Schneider makes delivery rounds through the bazaar: he brings knitted cloth to Harlan and reacts to business at the bazaar by arranging a resupply. His route is punctuated by thoughts of a cheese-shop snack or lunch, and he warmly calls one customer “sugar drop.” These exchanges present him as a sociable local whose work connects neighborhood customers and shops.

Watcher Cutford serves the Night Watch as a scout reporter and public lookout. He brings Mayor Ello reports of strange activity and graveyard scouts’ ominous findings, warning that Ello fears an attack on Darkshire; he also briefs Althea on graveyard reports. His warnings range from growls at the old hermit’s shack to wolves fleeing an unseen danger, and he calls the Night Watch to alert when a threat lurks in the wild.
Kargh Steelspine is an armorer.
A Menethil guard, representing the shared city-watch role rather than an individually named character.
Negolash is a hungry giant who reacts to food. When summoned, he says he smells food; he calls out over a feast and turns toward the nearest player.
A wretched zombie.
Mokk the Savage is an elusive white beast summoned by Witch Doctor Unbagwa in the search for a cure to Stranglethorn Fever. When badly wounded, it can erupt into a frenzy.
Konda is a named aggressive creature that can enter a frenzy when badly wounded, voicing a brief cry as it does.
A member of the Vile Fin murlocs.

Marzon the Silent Blade is a Defias conspirator involved in a planned meeting with Lord Gregor Lescovar. Elling Trias says he arranged their meeting using false information to expose the plot.
A Greater Feral Spirit.
A Skeletal Aberration.
An undead corpse eater.
A hissing undead ghoul.
A tortured undead soul.

A Cold Wraith is an undead creature that may carry an Ectoplasmic Resonator.
A Blood Wraith is an undead creature that may carry an Ectoplasmic Resonator.

Grand Inquisitor Isillien is a personally cruel enemy of Taelan Fordring. Though the Grand Crusader charged him with destroying Taelan and his friends, Isillien says he acts for pleasure. He mocks Taelan as weak like his father, Tirion, and hopes assassins have killed Tirion; he condemns the Fordring bloodline and taunts both father and son.

A Moonrage sentry, a humanoid guard associated with the Moonrage.
A Moonrage elder, a humanoid figure marked by seniority within the Moonrage.
A Scourge necromancer, an elite humanoid associated with the Scourge.

A dragonkin called Earth Miser, marked immune to Nature.
A dragonkin called Steel Miser, marked immune to physical damage.

Lillith Nefara is a powerful Scourge agent associated with the old, bloody altar off Gunther's island. When roused, she says her rest has been disturbed and threatens the intruder with her wrath.
Treant is an elemental creature, identified by its kind rather than a personal name.
A Dark Iron ambusher is sent into a sudden attack: it starts attacking as soon as it is summoned.
Gremlin is a humanoid creature.
Jaxil Rye is a humanoid.
Haggatha the Crone is a humanoid.

The Forlorn Spirit is tied to the legend of Stalvan and warns those who meddle in the past to leave it undisturbed. It speaks of ending or laying the legend to rest and casts Curse of Stalvan in combat.
Gunther's Minion is an undead creature.
Ravenclaw Apparition rallies its creations to prepare for an assault on the Forsaken, calling the Dark Lady's followers unable to stand against its might.
Councilman Smithers is identified with the Pyrewood Council. He uses Battle Roar and Demoralizing Shout, and casts Transform Visual when injured.
Councilman Thatcher is identified with the Pyrewood Council. In combat, he uses Battle Roar and Demoralizing Shout.
Councilman Hendricks is identified with the Pyrewood Council. He casts Transform Visual when injured.

Councilman Brunswick is identified as a member of the Pyrewood Council. In combat, he uses Battle Roar and Demoralizing Shout.
Lord Mayor Morrison leads the Pyrewood Council. When he is injured, he transforms into a Moonrage Sentry.

npcs.name: Billy the Street Urchin

records.text: Billy is a street urchin whose nameplate warns, “Don't trust me! I'm named Billy!” The joke gives him a wry introduction.

records.text: Warrior 25 is a humanoid warrior.
A Dark Iron raider with a blunt call to action: “Get him!” The raider starts attacking when it appears.
A Gravelflint scout, a humanoid identified by its scouting role.
Gravelflint Bonesnapper is a humanoid.
A Gravelflint geomancer.
Zora Guthrek is identified as a Trade Goods vendor; visitors can choose the gossip option to browse her goods.
Enraged Stanley is a beast.

This humanoid is identified as Horde Battleguard.

Connor McCoy is a spirit healer.
Bertran Keldrake is a spirit healer.
Corbin Halman is a spirit healer.
Reginald Berry is a spirit healer.

Helcular says he has returned from the grave to take revenge, naming Southshore as the target of his vengeance. He has risen and promises that the town will pay in blood; his threats invoke the undead and the Dark Lady. His words frame him as a vengeful figure aligned with the undead cause, with his grievance centered on Southshore.
A shadowy assassin who cloaks themself in stealth.
An enraged form of the skeletal fiend, an undead creature.
A flesh-eating worm that attacks when players are in range.
An elite flamescale drake, a beast.
Sloth is an undead combatant associated with the Sloth Effect in battle.
Sludge is an undead combatant that uses the Sludge ability in battle.
A remote-controlled mechanical golem.
An undead minion of Morganth.
A rough stone elemental.
Darbel Montrose is a Shadow Council warlock. She summons a succubus out of combat and casts Shadow Bolt in combat.
Foulbelly is a combatant who uses Aura of Rot outside combat and Slowing Poison in combat.
Ruul Onestone is a combatant. In combat, he uses Rain of Fire and Bloodlust.
Spirit of Old is an undead spirit.

Gazban is a goblin wizard whose connection to the Stone of Tides draws him toward the Altar of the Tides. When summoned there, he wonders aloud what force is pulling him in; when angered, he threatens to reveal the Stone’s true force. Others associate him with the water elementals and say he may have discovered the Stone, but those claims come from people seeking to investigate or claim it.
An undead Syndicate spectre.
Port Master Szik is a boat vendor.
A compact mechanical harvest reaper.
A Hill Giant, a giant creature.
A Hill Giant Warden is a giant entrusted with keeping watch, a duty that sets it apart from hill giants without that title.
Shadra is identified as a spider god of the Hinterlands. She is summoned at the altar of Shadra'Alor in the Witherbark realm, where challengers are directed to defeat her and seek her venom.
A Shadowforge excavator, defined by the work of digging and removing material for Shadowforge.
A Stonevault warden, defined by the duty of guarding Stonevault and its holdings.

Myzrael is a princess of the earth whom giants trapped beneath the Arathi Highlands. She says she has been freed and is gathering strength to confront them. If summoned before she is ready, she turns on the ally who helped her and warns that they will pay.

Blacklash is a black drake imprisoned with Hematus in Lethlor Ravine. Horde accounts identify the pair as Deathwing's lieutenants from the Second War. Their prison depends on three runestones, and accounts warn that the drakes are dangerous; Blacklash also uses a flame breath.

Hematus is a black drake, described as one of Deathwing’s lieutenants during the Second War and imprisoned in Lethlor Ravine. Horde accounts treat his release as a danger, and he uses Flame Buffet in combat.
Thenan warns intruders not to summon Myzrael, calling the attempt foolish. He delivers this warning when engaged, giving him a clear role in opposing Myzrael’s summoning.
A Daggerspine Marauder is an aggressive raider who treats the treasure as its own and threatens plunderers with a watery grave.
Vengeful Surge is an elemental that can cast Frost Nova.
A summoned guardian.
Hovrak Gutrender bears the title “Baby Murloc Redemption Merchant,” associating him with redeeming baby murlocs.
Tresa MacGregor is a Baby Murloc redemption merchant.
A Daggerspine wavecaller.
A freed druid of the Talon.
A warrior.
A warrior.
A warrior.
A warrior.
A warrior.
Grunenstur Balindom is a Crocilisk trainer.
Durdek Karrin bears the title Bear Trainer.
The Ranged Skills Trainer is a ranged skills trainer.
Prismatic Exile is an elemental that casts Lightning Shield and Fireball in combat.
A Stonevault trogg.
Stonevault Scout is an elite humanoid identified by its scouting role among the Stonevault.
Stonevault Skullthumper is a rank-and-file humanoid of the Stonevault, named for its bruising combat role. Unlike the elite Scout, it is an ordinary member of the group.

Hammertoe's Spirit tells Karnik that Ragnaros's influence is spreading and promises more explanation later. For now, he asks Karnik to send the traveler to Belgrum, showing that he has urgent business beyond their conversation.
The Fam'retor Guardian is an elemental that can be ripped apart as it is banished from the world.
Keeper Bel'dugur and Gerrig Bonegrip each seek the Hand of Dagun from Dagun the Ravenous as one of three items of power.
Aldric Hunter is a bear trainer.
Jackson Bayne is a boar trainer.
Dylan Bissel is a wolf trainer who sells goods.
Puppet of Helcular is an elite demon that becomes aggressive when summoned.

A silent, uncanny beast that draws energy from the earth and gives a long, deliberate howl, sometimes gazing northwest. Its strange display suggests a close tie to the land, though its purpose beyond these brief appearances is unknown.
Captain Obvious is identified as a boat operator.
Cap'n Copyright is identified as a boat operator.
Eric's AAA Special Vendor.
Scott Mercer, a humanoid character.
Ishamuhale, called Speartooth, is a sunscale raptor whom Jorn describes as driven to hunt by passion and nature rather than hunger. Jorn says a zhevra carcass can draw him out.
A Bristleback defender.
A Bristleback mystic.
The Spirit of Minshina is a humanoid spirit that can be summoned.

Morgan Ladimore is a troubled spirit who speaks of Archeus, the sword that served him in life. He hopes to pass from his unhappy existence, clings to his daughter’s love, and hopes the Light will forgive his sins.
Mandrik's wife, a humanoid character.
Grelkor is a blacksmithing-supplies vendor who also offers repairs.

Verog the Dervish is a centaur associated with the command tent at the Stagnant Oasis. When summoned, he calls intruders to his tent and challenges them to face their death, marking him as a hostile encounter figure.
Living Flame is an elemental that uses its namesake Living Flames spell in combat.
Crekori Mudwater, a humanoid character.
Defias Companion is a beast identified by its association with the Defias.

Pilot Wizzlecrank is stranded after wrecking his shredder. He asks the player to report the wreck to Sputtervalve in Ratchet, while he stays behind to guard it and worries the smoke will give it away.

Sergra Darkthorn describes Echeyakee, called Whitemist in Tauren, as king of the savannah cats, famed for stealth and swift kills. Tauren say he is both mercy and death. Sergra directs the hunter to summon him at a lair northeast of the Crossroads.
The Moonrage Armorer is an armorer who offers goods for browsing.
A Moonrage Tailor associated with Pyrewood's enchanted shackles. Dalar Dawnweaver seeks these shackles to study the enchantment that turns Pyrewood's villagers into Moonrage Worgen after dark.
A Moonrage Leatherworker associated with Pyrewood's enchanted shackles. Dalar Dawnweaver seeks these shackles to study the enchantment that turns Pyrewood's villagers into Moonrage Worgen after dark.
This dwarf is identified as a poison-supplies vendor.
A dwarf reagent vendor.
A bogling that shouts “Kill!!!” in combat and is announced as rising from the soil.
A newly cleansed timberling seedling that happily follows its new companion and promises to protect them.
Praenus Raxxeus is identified as a Bat Handler. His role centers on handling bats.
A beast named Crafticus Rabbitus.

Aman is an enigmatic presence who asks who summoned him. He recognizes the listener's work with relics of the past, cautions that creators can be fallible, and warns that probing too deeply into the listener's past may end their future.
Rarck is a general goods merchant who lets customers browse his wares.
Mutanus the Devourer is a named encounter foe whose attacks include Naralex's Nightmare, Terrify and Thundercrack.
A tormented Highborne soul in humanoid form.
A beast called Serpentbloom Snake that begins wandering randomly when summoned.

Grimclaw communicates with Terenthis through roars, moans, and stamping paws, and the druid gradually understands him. He greets his master Volcor with excitement and a face-lick, while cautiously growling at a visitor before sniffing them.
Kyln Longclaw is a boar trainer.
Nerra is a cat trainer.
Aelyssa is identified as a Spirit Healer.
Myielea Starwhisper is identified as a Spirit Healer.
An Initiate Druid is a novice member of the druidic tradition, identified by that rank.
A Druid of the Wild is identified by a title linking the druidic role with the wild.
A Cenarion steward.
Voidlasher is a demon.

Anaya is the long-lost love of Cerellean Whiteclaw, separated from him since the ancient destruction of Ameth’Aran. Her words describe their reunion with enduring affection, and she says Cerellean freed her from slavery. As the ties binding her to this world weaken, she departs with a promise that her love will remain.
A humanoid known as the Shadowfang Bloodhowler.
Shadowfang Tainted One is a humanoid.
A lesser gargoyle, an undead creature.
Stone Sleeper is an undead creature.
A traumatized undead spirit.
Magthrull's Doomguard is a demon.
A humanoid assassin identified with the Dark Strand.

The Forsaken Scout threatens a paladin, saying that killing him would please the scout’s “master,” and attacks. This gives the scout a clear hostile aim and places the scout under someone else’s authority.
Captain Noteo is identified as a Boat Operator.
Captain Hart is a boat operator.
Aligar the Tormentor is a hostile combatant who enters battle in Battle Stance, then taunts a paladin as someone who cannot hide from “us.” His words frame the encounter as a personal pursuit.

Balizar the Umbrage is a hostile combatant who mocks an opponent for being less sure without the Purifier, singling out that figure as important to the confrontation. In combat, he casts Curse of Agony and Curse of Weakness.
Caedakar the Vicious is a named combatant who uses Lightning Shield and Lightning Bolt.
Roth Bluntblade is identified as Kira's guard.

Velinde Starsong laments failing her people as worgen run rampant and the goddess's scythe is lost. She prayed to Elune for strength against Felwood's demons; when the scythe came, she recognized it as a weapon granted to defeat them. She fears the evil she unleashed and prays.
Jainay Featherbreeze supplies cooking goods.
Kaleem is identified as a cook.
Agro 5.
Agro 7.
Agro 10.
A humanoid Venture Co. cutter, this company member holds a hands-on role in Venture Co. work.
A humanoid leader within the Venture Co., the Overboss holds a senior place in the company's ranks.
Despite its vermin name, a Windshear Vermin is a humanoid creature.
Windshear Tunnel Rats act as tunnel guards, warning intruders and calling their fellows when someone trespasses.
A Windshear Stonecutter is a humanoid worker who runs for help when gravely wounded.
A Charred Stone Spirit is an elemental being of scorched rock.
Dinnis is a named spirit healer, a supernatural caretaker.
Mirkfallon Glade Strider is a named humanoid.
A Forest Spirit.
The Serpent Messenger is a serpent whose task is delivering a message to Apothecary Zamah.
The Venture Co. Planner carries a planning title.
The Venture Co. Grinder is identified by its grinder title.
The Galak Pack Runner is identified as a pack runner.
A Gravelsnout digger that fights using Skull Crack.
A wandering boulderkin, identified as a creature of elemental type.
Kesteryth is a foraging trainer.
Kysandia is a cat trainer.
Kitari Farseeker is a cartography trainer.
Siannai is an arrow merchant.
Ki'rasia is a cloth armor merchant.
Shaia is a mail armor merchant.
Freillania is a shield merchant.
Talar is a bear trainer.
Valyen Wolfsong is a wolf trainer who offers goods for browsing. Mistrunner is his pet.
Talegon is a cartography supplies merchant.
Urthoniir is a leather armor merchant.
Lewin Starfeather is a leather armor merchant.
Mistrunner is identified as Valyen Wolfsong's pet, linking this beast to the wolf trainer.
Brogus Thunderbrew is a food-and-drink vendor whose goods are available to browse.
Lana Thunderbrew supplies blacksmithing goods, which visitors can browse; she also offers repairs.
The Deepmoss Hatchling is a young creature that chitters for help. Its hatching is announced, and when injured it can cast Summon Deepmoss Matriarch.
The Deepmoss Matriarch is a beast whose arrival is marked by a brief cue; after evading, she is set to despawn.
Eye of Kilrogg is a demon.
A Scarlet Scryer is a rank-and-file figure identified by a scrying role.
Corthryn is a Spirit Healer.
A dragonkin called a Firemane Devourer.
Mirallia is a Spirit Healer.
A beast called a Drywallow Vicejaw.
A Mirefin Puddlejumper whose head Mudcrush Durtfeet seeks for food.
A Mirefin Warrior whose head Mudcrush Durtfeet seeks for food.

A beast associated with the Pendant of Myzrael, whose plea reaches the finder through the shard and points toward a crystal in Arathi's northern mountains. The Bark Ripper's role in that story is the pendant's acquisition; the vision and plea belong to the item and its quest.
A Swamp Ooze, a named ooze creature.
A Corrosive Swamp Ooze, a named ooze creature.
A Blistering Swamp Ooze, a named ooze creature.

A burrowing Mudrock turtle whose forked tongue is sought by Theramore cook Morgan Stern for Mudrock Soup and Bugs. The dish calls for hunting Mudrocks along the Dustwallow Marsh coast, and this creature can yield a Forked Mudrock Tongue.
Muckshell Snapclaw is a Muckshell creature.
Muckshell Razorclaw is a Muckshell creature.
Darkfang Lurker is a creature whose name identifies it as a lurking member of the Darkfang group.
Darkfang Spider is a spider associated by name with the Darkfang group.
Wazza is identified as a totem merchant.
Griznak is a race vendor.
Mazzer Stripscrew is a race vendor.
Crazzle Sprysprocket is identified as a gnome ticket redeemer, with a questgiver interaction.
Rugfizzle is identified as a goblin ticket redeemer.
An undead Skeletal Adept.
A Screaming Haunt is an undead creature that may carry an Ectoplasmic Resonator.
A wolf identified as Vilebranch, a beast tied to the Vilebranch name.
Kodiak is a humanoid.

Grenka Bloodscreech is a named opponent of Dorn Plainstalker’s endurance test. Dorn directs challengers to the Roguefeather Den to destroy its food stores; if they survive long enough, Grenka comes after them, and he asks for her claw as proof of completing the trial.
A beast named Woof.
Captain Quirk is identified as a boat operator.
Frostmaw is a yeti whose white coat blends into the snow, making him elusive in the Alterac Mountains.

During the Sundering, Sargath was among those trapped at Ameth'Aran after Athrikus promised protection and instead drained their power. He says hundreds were imprisoned and only a few remain; Athrikus's lieutenant Ilkrud Magthrull has a tome that might reveal the remaining soulgems' location.
Wind Howler is an elemental.
Stone Rumbler is an elemental.
Tamed Hyena is a tamed hyena.
Tamed Battleboar is a beast identified as tamed. It casts a spell when drawn into combat.
Rebald Yorglun is a raptor trainer.
CHOW Guard is a guard.
Arugal’s Voidwalker is a demon with combat behavior: it casts Dark Offering on a friendly target with missing health and attacks when ready for combat.
Maraudine Bonepaw is a beast.
A Burning Blade conjuror: a member of the clan’s spellcasting ranks.
A Doomwarder Lord, a powerful demon.
A beast known as Murderous Bonepaw.
A kodo known as Raging Kodo.
A Maraudine pack runner.
A gray ram, an ordinary animal identified by its kind and coloring.
A Slitherblade tide priestess, a member of the naga group with a religious role.
Sandstrider is a creature called a Sandstrider.
Crazed Sandstrider is a creature bearing the distinction “Crazed.”
White Ram is a ram distinguished by its white coloring.
Frost Ram is a ram distinguished by its name.
Black Ram is a ram distinguished by its black coloring.
An Illusionary Nightmare.
A creature named Force of Nature.
Murkshallow Shellhide is a humanoid.
A rabid shrike bat, a beast.
Varng is a turtle trainer.
The Haunting Spirit is an undead combat creature that can join battle when it appears.
An Old Town thug serving under a boss, this subordinate agrees to orders readily but questions whether a proposed task is worth the effort. He is a practiced fighter, hostile on appearing.
A Defias agent.
When danger exceeds expectations, Slim's Friend abandons Slim and tells him he is on his own.
Kagoro gives a terse acknowledgment and says he will return shortly, leaving his immediate business unclear.
Elise Laughlin is a named Guild Tabard Designer, associated with creating guild tabards.
Murkshallow Softshell is a summoned combatant that joins the fight across the area when called.
An elite servant of Aku'mai, this creature fights with Frostbolt Volley.
A druid trainer, associated with the practice of druidism. The available record gives no personal history or distinctive teaching approach.
A hunter trainer, associated with the hunter's craft. The available record gives no personal history or distinctive teaching approach.
A mage trainer, associated with the study of magic. The available record gives no personal history or distinctive teaching approach.
A paladin trainer, associated with the paladin's calling. The available record gives no personal history or distinctive teaching approach.
A priest trainer, associated with the priesthood. The available record gives no personal history or distinctive teaching approach.

Dorius was a member of an archaeological team who found the Suntara stones at Grimesilt and turned to Ragnaros, who gave him purpose and renamed him Lathoric the Black. He manipulated his brother into sending rescuers, then revealed he had used them to recover the last stone from the Twilight’s Hammer. He intended Obsidion to destroy the Blackrock orcs and unite his followers with their fiery brethren.
The Hakkari Bloodkeeper is a combatant that summons a demon when it respawns, starts attacks out of combat, and uses Shadow Bolt and Corruption in battle.

Kalaran is a deceiver allied with Maltrake and the Blackrock Legion. He admits that he used the player's help to advance the Legion's invasion of the gorge, boasts of the destruction to come, then leaves the player alive and has Maltrake present trinkets. He also says his kin in the Burning Steppes can use black dragon molt to fortify crafted items.
A Nightmare Suppressor is one of Hakkar’s defenders, alarmed by anyone trying to summon their god. The voice shifts from defiant warnings to startled confusion when events turn against them.

A Frost Spectre that enters combat and attacks.
A demon known as the Plaguehound Mastiff.
An angered infernal.
A screecher spirit that appears hovering over its fallen body, gazing beyond the player. Yeh'kinya's quest identifies these spirits as vale screecher spirits in Feralas and links them to an old god.

Ozzie Togglevolt is a gnome associated with Kharanos. A local account identifies him as Razzle's partner and says they are working on a solution to Gnomeregan's sickness; quest directions send visitors to speak with Ozzie there.
A mechanical dragonling.
An Infernal Servant, a demon.

A Splinterbone undead of elite rank.
A felhound that searches for a source of arcane energy and growls.
A gnome trainer for Gnomish Engineering.
A goblin trainer for Goblin Engineering.
An elite infernal demon, known as a Massive Infernal.
A Forest Creeper.
A emerald dragon whelp that uses Acid Spit in combat.
Seinrick Coulthane is a skinning trainer.
A mechanical chicken that uses Battle Squawk in combat.
A Sandfury acolyte that fights by casting Shadow Bolt.
A Sandfury zealot that grows more dangerous when badly wounded, becoming frenzied and crying out. When summoned, it moves unpredictably.
A mechanical Mechastrider.
A dredge worm that poisons its foes in combat.
A deep stinger that attacks with a cleaving strike.
A dark screecher that attacks with a Sonic Burst.
A burrowing thundersnout that attacks with Lizard Bolt.
A borer beetle that pierces its foes' armor.

An alternate paladin combatant.
A Firegut captain and hostile combatant.
A voidwalker minion that fights with Shadowstrike.
A Sentinel Hill innkeeper who offers goods for browsing.
Northshire Guard Justin is a named guard who offers a questgiver interaction.
A warhorse, identified as a beast.

A humanoid named Launcher.
Launcher2 is a humanoid.
An enraged wyvern, this creature uses Poison while fighting.
A Twilight's Hammer executioner, an elite combatant.
Known as the Sleeping Dragon, this powerful dragon is identified by its dormant state.
A Spawn of Bael'Gar, this creature bears a name linking it to Bael'Gar.
Dark Keeper Vorfalk is an elite hostile spellcaster, using Lightning Bolt and Shock in combat.
Dark Keeper Bethek is an elite hostile spellcaster, using Fireball and Amplify Damage in combat.
Dark Keeper Uggel is a Blackrock Depths dungeon adversary whose combat kit combines Shadow Bolt with Curse of Agony, pairing direct shadow damage with a lingering curse.
Dark Keeper Zimrel is a Blackrock Depths dungeon adversary who uses Holy Smite and can protect himself with Power Word: Shield, giving his fighting style both offensive and defensive magic.
Dark Keeper Ofgut is a Blackrock Depths dungeon adversary whose combat magic combines Arcane Bolt with an Anti-Magic Shield, matching an arcane attack with magical protection.
Dark Keeper Pelver is a Blackrock Depths dungeon adversary who maintains Frost Armor outside combat and attacks with Frostbolt when fighting.
The Dark Guard is a Blackrock Depths dungeon guard that attacks nearby opponents with Strike.

Aquementas resents being roused from his rest and asks who dared awaken him. He performs a powerful spell that transforms the gathered items into a totem, making him the indispensable magical agent in this encounter.
A Kolkar warlord and leader of the force sent against the Barrens bunkers. He declares the Kolkar strongest and fights with a strike.
A Horde defender who raises a final cry when falling in battle.
A Horde axe thrower assigned to defend the bunkers; in battle, it promises the enemy’s fall and calls for the Alliance’s death.
Cyrus’s frenzied black drake minion, which surges into a frenzy in combat and attacks with flame breath.
An alert watchman in Blackrock Depths’ lower vault; he shouts at intruders, uses Sunder Armor, and drinks a healing potion when badly hurt.
A cloned ooze, defined by its copied nature rather than a personal name.
A Gorishi grub.
An enraged felbat, able to use Poison in combat.
An elite Blackrock ambusher, a humanoid.
A Kolkar stormseer caster, able to use Lightning Cloud and roam.
A Kolkar invader who charges at foes and uses Strike in combat.
An enraged gryphon that uses Rend in combat.
An enraged hippogryph that can use Rend in combat.

As the Kargath Expeditionary Force's High Executioner, Nuzrak is ordered forward by Shadow of Lexlort during Grark Lorkrub's treason hearing. He raises his massive axe over Grark, taking part in the proceedings as executioner.

Shadow of Lexlort is a Kargath Expeditionary Force officer who conducts Grark Lorkrub's treason proceedings. He declares Grark guilty, says the plea is unimportant, orders Nuzrak forward to execute him, and sends a soldier back to Kargath.
Franclorn's Spirit, a humanoid spirit.

Raschal is a courier who says he was given time to escape and intends to stealth back to the Stronghold. Still dizzy after thinking he was about to die, he thanks an unnamed helper and invokes Elune's blessing.
A Felhound Minion is a demonic subordinate. Its title indicates a lesser serving role.

A ravasaur counted among Lar'korwi's mates; it is a wild animal rather than a known speaker or quest contact. It fights with Rend and Tendon Rip.

Lar'korwi is the dominant male ravasaur of Un'Goro Crater, feared by Torwa Pathfinder. Torwa says Lar'korwi killed his brother after the brother took meat from one of the creature's kills, and describes Lar'korwi as a persistent hunter. Torwa later devised a plan to lure the predator with meat and scent.

An illusionary dragonkin dreamwatcher.
Lithilia is a humanoid.
Locheed speaks with relief after being freed and immediately plans to leave, telling his rescuer to take care. His words suggest an informal, colloquial manner.

A stable master who greets visitors and offers help with pet stabling and recovering lost companions. The greeting addresses the visitor by class, while the two service options distinguish stable care from lost-companion assistance.
A corrupted kitten, identified by its corrupted state.
